required_behavior: Keep registration record, described resource, dataset and distribution identities distinct.
unsafe_inference: A catalog record is the cataloged resource or dataset.

required_behavior: Validate, attribute and publish assertions separately from the extraction receipt.
unsafe_inference: A successful extraction means every returned field is an accepted assertion.

required_behavior: Require exact protocol deletion semantics or retain absence as unknown.
unsafe_inference: A missing record in one harvest proves deletion.

required_behavior: Advance only after an exact accepted cursor-commit receipt.
unsafe_inference: Starting or scheduling a harvest permits cursor advancement.

required_behavior: Preserve transformation profile and residual information loss.
unsafe_inference: Normalized metadata is semantically identical to its source payload.

required_behavior: Keep confidence, provenance, authority and truth separate.
unsafe_inference: A high-confidence metadata assertion is true or authoritative.

required_behavior: Bind it as an immutable derived projection of exact assertion editions.
unsafe_inference: A discovery document is the source assertion or source record.

required_behavior: Require independent policy, authority and effect decisions.
unsafe_inference: Visibility in search grants access, certification or endorsement.

required_behavior: Publish profile- and cut-bound ranking evidence only.
unsafe_inference: Top-ranked result is the most relevant or correct asset in reality.

required_behavior: Report query cut, visibility, coverage, truncation and provider receipt.
unsafe_inference: Empty search results prove source-population absence.

required_behavior: Require explicit peer editions, precedence and conflict policy.
unsafe_inference: Federation may resolve every peer conflict with ambient latest-write-wins.

required_behavior: Measure freshness from supplied successful observations and an explicit clock.
unsafe_inference: A scheduled harvest proves fresh metadata.

required_behavior: Keep freshness, coverage, correctness, fitness and authority independent.
unsafe_inference: Freshness and coverage SLO pass proves content correctness.

required_behavior: Treat suggestions as attributed proposals subject to deterministic laws and named authority.
unsafe_inference: A model or agent may establish identity, delete records, grant visibility or certify a result.
